Description: Sets the server owner's RuneScape: Dragonwilds EOS Player ID. This can be found in-game at the bottom of the Settings Menu
Sets the 'CREATED BY' name for the server shown in the client server list. Maximum 64 characters
Sets the name of the default world that is created on start. This is shown as the server name in the client server list and is used for search. Case-sensitive. Maximum 64 characters
Sets the admin password, allowing access to the Server Management tab in-game. Default is a secure random password
Sets the password required to join the server. Empty = no password

Sets the action to take when the server is updated. If installing, the [UE4SS-RE experimental build](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental) set in UE4SS Build Version is extracted into RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Win64 (dwmapi.dll plus the ue4ss folder). Existing UE4SS files, including ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini and ue4ss/Mods/mods.txt, are not overwritten. CurseForge mods install into RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods

Sets the [UE4SS-RE experimental build](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental) to install when Install UE Scripting System is set to install. The default, v3.0.1-944-g0196ef29, is the build CurseForge installs (it reports itself as Git SHA #0196ef29 in UE4SS.log) for RuneScape: Dragonwilds UE4SS mods. Because existing files are not overwritten, remove UE4SS first when changing builds
